verses.en: Then he called his twelve disciples together, and gave them power and authority over all devils, and to cure diseases.
verses.sm: Atua Ua faapotopotoina e ia le toasefulu ma le toalua, ua tuu atu ia te i latou le mana ma le pule i temoni uma, ma ia faamalolo i maʻi.

verses.en: And he sent them to preach the kingdom of God, and to heal the sick.
verses.sm: Ua aauina atu i latou e ia e talaʻi i le malo o le Atua, e faamalolo foi i e mamai.

verses.en: And he said unto them, Take nothing for your journey, neither staves, nor scrip, neither bread, neither money; neither have two coats apiece.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu foi o ia ia te i latou, “Aua tou te ave se mea i le malaga, po o tootoo, PO O se taga, po o mea e ʻai, po o se tupe, aua foi neʻi tailua ofutino.

verses.en: And whatsoever house ye enter into, there abide, and thence depart.
verses.sm: O se fale foi tou te ulu atu i ai, ia nonofo ai i le tou o ai lava.

verses.en: And whosoever will not receive you, when ye go out of that city, shake off the very dust from your feet for a testimony against them.
verses.sm: Ai se lē talia outou, a outou o ese i lea aai, ia tūtū atu le eleele i o outou vae, e fai ma molimau ia te i latou.”

verses.en: And they departed, and went through the towns, preaching the gospel, and healing every where.
verses.sm: Ua latou o atu, ona faataamilo ai lea i lea aai ma lea aai e folafola le tala lelei, ma faamalolo i ta“ i mea uma.

verses.en: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him: and he was perplexed, because that it was said of some, that John was risen from the dead;
verses.sm: Ua faalogo le tupu o Herota i mea uma ua faia e ia, ona fememeai lea o ia, ina ua fai mai nisi, ua tu mai Ioane i e ua oti;

verses.en: And of some, that Elias had appeared; and of others, that one of the old prophets was risen again.
verses.sm: 8ao isi, ua faaali mai Elia; a o isi, ua toe tu mai le tasi o le au perofeta anamua.

verses.en: And Herod said, John have I beheaded: but who is this, of whom I hear such things? And he desired to see him.
verses.sm: A ua fai ane Herota, “Na ou vavaeeseina le ulu o Ioane; a o ai lenei ua ou faalogo ai i mea faapena?” Ua manao o ia i le fia vaai ia te ja.

verses.en: And the apostles, when they were returned, told him all that they had done. And he took them, and went aside privately into a desert place belonging to the city called Bethsaida.
verses.sm: Ua toe foi mai le au aposetolo, ma faamatala mai ia te ia mea uma ua latou faia; ona ave lea o ia ia te i latou, ua 6 na o i latou i le tasi nuu, o Petesaita le igoa.

verses.en: And the people, when they knew it, followed him: and he received them, and spake unto them of the kingdom of God, and healed them that had need of healing.
verses.sm: Ua iloa e le motu O tagata, ona latou mulimuli atu lea ia te ia; ona talia lea o i latou e ia, ua fetalai foi ia te i latou i le malo o le Atua, ma faamalolo i e na fia faamaloloina.

verses.en: And when the day began to wear away, then came the twelve, and said unto him, Send the multitude away, that they may go into the towns and country round about, and lodge, and get victuals: for we are here in a desert place.
verses.sm: Ua taugagaifo le la, ona o mai lea ia te ia o le toasefulu ma le toalua, ua fai mai, “Ta e tuuina atu le motu o tagata, ina ia latou o atu i aai ma faoa aai ua latalata mai, e api ai, ma maua ai rnea e ‘ai; aua o le mea gaogao uatatouiai nei.”

verses.en: But he said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they said, We have no more but five loaves and two fishes; except we should go and buy meat for all this people.
verses.sm: A ua fetalai atu ia ia te i latou, “Ta outou avane ni mea e ‘ai má latou.” Ona latou fai mai lea, “E leai ni a tatou mea, na o areto e lima gafua, ma iʻa e lua lav; seʻi iloga matou te o e faatau ni mea e “ai ma nei tagata uma.”

verses.en: For they were about five thousand men. And he said to his disciples, Make them sit down by fifties in a company.
verses.sm: Aua o i latou pe toalimagaafe o tane. Ua fetalai atu o ia i ona soo, “Ir outou fai atu ia te i latou ia taooto i vasega, pe taitoalimagafulu.

verses.en: And they did so, and made them all sit down.
verses.sm: Ua latou faapea lava ona fai, ma fai atu ia te i latou uma ia taooto i lalo.

verses.en: Then he took the five loaves and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed them, and brake, and gave to the disciples to set before the multitude.
verses.sm: Ona tago ai lea o ia i areto e lima gafua, ma ifa e lua lau, ua tepa ae i le lagi, ua faafetai, ma tofitofi, ua avatu i ona soo, latou te laulau atu ai i le motu o tavara.

verses.en: And they did eat, and were all filled: and there was taken up of fragments that remained to them twelve baskets.
verses.sm: Ua latou aai, ua maoona uma lava; ona fuʻe lea o a latou toe “aiga, ua tumu ato e sefulu ma le lua i fāsi mea.

verses.en: And it came to pass, as he was alone praying, his disciples were with him: and he asked them, saying, Whom say the people that I am?
verses.sm: Ua tatalo toatasi o ia; sa faatasi ma ia cna soo; ona fesili atu lea o ia ia te i latou, “Se a le upu a tagata ia te au poo ai?”

verses.en: They answering said, John the Baptist; but some say, Elias; and others say, that one of the old prophets is risen again.
verses.sm: Ua latou tali mai, “O Ioane le papatiso; a o isi, O Elia; a o isi, Ua toe tu mai le tasi o le au perofeta anamua.”

verses.en: He said unto them, But whom say ye that I am? Peter answering said, The Christ of God.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu o ia ia te i latou, “A o outou na, se a la outou upu ia te au nei po o ai?” Ona tali mai lea o Peteru, “O oe ole Keriso o le Atua.”

verses.en: And he straitly charged them, and commanded them to tell no man that thing;
verses.sm: Ona vavao atu lea o ia ia te i latou, ua fetalai atu, neʻi ta‘uta‘ua lea mea i se tasi;

verses.en: Saying, The Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be slain, and be raised the third day.
verses.sm: ua faapea atu, “E tatau ona tiga le Atalii o le tagata i mea e tele, ma ia lafoaiina e toeaina, ma ositaulaga sili, ma le au tusiupu, ia fasiotia foi; e faatuina foi o ia i le aso tolu.”

verses.en: And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu o ia i tagata uma, “A fia mulimuli mai se tasi ia te au, ia faafiti o ia ia te ia, ma ave lona satauro i aso fai soo, i le mulimuli mai ia te au.

verses.en: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: but whosoever will lose his life for my sake, the same shall save it.
verses.sm: Aua ai sé fia faasaogalemuina lona ola, e máumau ai ia te ia; a o le faamáumau i lona ola ona o aʻu, e faasaoina e ia.

verses.en: For what is a man advantaged, if he gain the whole world, and lose himself, or be cast away?
verses.sm: Aua se a le aoga i le tagata pe afai na te maua le lalolagi uma, a e faamaumau e ia ia ia, pe lafoaiina?

verses.en: For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words, of him shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he shall come in his own glory, and in his Father's, and of the holy angels.
verses.sm: Aua ai se mà ia te au ma aʻu upu, e ma foi ia te ia le Atalii o le tagata, pe a sau o ia i lona mamalu, ma lo le Tama, ma le au agelu paia.

verses.en: But I tell you of a truth, there be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the kingdom of God.
verses.sm: E moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, o loo tutú mai nisi iinei, e le oo ia te i latou le oti, seia latou vaaia le malo o le Atua.”

verses.en: And it came to pass about an eight days after these sayings, he took Peter and John and James, and went up into a mountain to pray.
verses.sm: Ua mavae nei upu, po ua po valu, ona ave lea e ia o Peteru, ma Ioane, ma Iakopo, ua maliu ae i le mauga c tatalo.

verses.en: And as he prayed, the fashion of his countenance was altered, and his raiment was white and glistering.
verses.sm: O loo tatalo ia, a ua liua ona fofoga, ua pa‘epa‘e ma pupula tele mai ona ofu.

verses.en: And, behold, there talked with him two men, which were Moses and Elias:
verses.sm: Faauta foi, ua tautala ma ia o tagata e toalua, o Mose ma Elia i laua,

verses.en: Who appeared in glory, and spake of his decease which he should accomplish at Jerusalem.
verses.sm: O e na faaali mai ma le pupula; ua latou fetautalatala‘i i lona maliu o le a faataunuuina i Ierusalema.

verses.en: But Peter and they that were with him were heavy with sleep: and when they were awake, they saw his glory, and the two men that stood with him.
verses.sm: A ua moe gagase Peteru ma e ua faatasi ma ia; ua latou ala, ona latou iloa lea o lona pupula, ma tagata e toalua o e ua tutu faatasi ma ia.

verses.en: And it came to pass, as they departed from him, Peter said unto Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias: not knowing what he said.
verses.sm: Ua oo ina la o ese ia te ia, ona fai mai lea o Peteru ia Iesu, “Le Alii e, e lelei ona ua tatou iinei; seʻi matou faia foi ni fale apitaga se tolu; mo oe le tasi, mo Mose le tasi, mo Elia foi le tasi”; ua le iloa e ia le mea ua ja fai atu ai.

verses.en: While he thus spake, there came a cloud, and overshadowed them: and they feared as they entered into the cloud.
verses.sm: O loo fai mai ia mea, a e oo mai le ao, ma faamalumalu ifo ia i latou; ua latou matatau ina ua ulu i le ao.

verses.en: And there came a voice out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.
verses.sm: Ona oo mai lea o le siufofoga mai le ao, ua faapea mai, “O loʻu Atalii lena, o lē ua Filifilia; ia outou faalogo ia te ia.”

verses.en: And when the voice was past, Jesus was found alone. And they kept it close, and told no man in those days any of those things which they had seen.
verses.sm: Ua mavae atu le siufofoga, ona iloa mai lea na o Iesu. Latou te lei gagana lava, e lei taʻu atu foi i se tasi i ia ona aso se mea e tasi o mea ua latou vaai i ai.

verses.en: And it came to pass, that on the next day, when they were come down from the hill, much people met him.
verses.sm: O le taeao ua latou o ifo ai i le mauga, ona fetaiai lea ma ia o le motu o tagata e toatele.

verses.en: And, behold, a man of the company cried out, saying, Master, I beseech thee, look upon my son: for he is mine only child.
verses.sm: Faauta foi, ua alaga mai le tasi nai le motu o tagata, “Le aʻoaʻo e, ou te aioi atu ia te oe, e te silasila mai i loʻu atalii; auā o ia o loʻu atalii e toatasi.

verses.en: And, lo, a spirit taketh him, and he suddenly crieth out; and it teareth him that he foameth again, and bruising him hardly departeth from him.
verses.sm: Faauta foi, ua pue ia te ia e le agaga, ona alaga loa lea, ma faataafiti ia te ia, ma ua fāuā lona gutu, ua tuʻi fulifuli ia te ia, toe ina le alu ese ia te ia.

verses.en: And I besought thy disciples to cast him out; and they could not.
verses.sm: Na ou aioi atu foi i ou soo ia latou tuli ia te ia i fafo; a ua latou le mafaia lava.”

verses.en: And Jesus answering said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you, and suffer you? Bring thy son hither.
verses.sm: Ua tali atu Iesu, “Le tupulaga lē faatuatua ma le faapiopio, ou te i ai ia te outou, ma onosai ia te outou seia afea? Ina au mai ia lou atalii iinei.”

verses.en: And as he was yet a coming, the devil threw him down, and tare him. And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the child, and delivered him again to his father.
verses.sm: O loo sau ia, a e lafotu ma faataafiti ia te ia e le temoni. Ona vavao lea e Iesu j le agaga leaga, ma ua faamalolo i le tama, ma toe tuu atu ia te ia i lona tama.

verses.en: And they were all amazed at the mighty power of God. But while they wondered every one at all things which Jesus did, he said unto his disciples,
verses.sm: Ua latou matua ofo uma i le mana mamalu o le Atua. O loo ofo i latou uma i mea uma na faia e ia, cna fetalai atu lea o ia i ona soo,

verses.en: Let these sayings sink down into your ears: for the Son of man shall be delivered into the hands of men.
verses.sm: “la outou matuá faalogologo i nei upu, auà o le a tuuina atu le Atalii o le tagata i lima O tagata.”

verses.en: But they understood not this saying, and it was hid from them, that they perceived it not: and they feared to ask him of that saying.
verses.sm: A ua le iloa e i latou lea upu, ua lilo ia te i latou, o lea na latou le lagona ai lea mea; ua latou matatau foi e fesili ia te ia i lea upu.

verses.en: Then there arose a reasoning among them, which of them should be greatest.
verses.sm: Ua tupu le finauga ia te i latou, po o ai so latou e sili.

verses.en: And Jesus, perceiving the thought of their heart, took a child, and set him by him,
verses.sm: Ua silafia e Iesu le manatu o o latou loto, ona tago lea o ia i le tamaitiiti, ma faatu ia te ia i ona tafatafa.

verses.en: And said unto them, Whosoever shall receive this child in my name receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me receiveth him that sent me: for he that is least among you all, the same shall be great.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu o ia ia te i latou, “Ai sé talia lenei tamaitiiti i loʻu igoa, ua talia aʻu e ia; ai sē talia foi aʻu, ua talia e ia le na auina mai aʻu; aua o le aupito itiiti ia te outou uma, e sili lava ia.”

verses.en: And John answered and said, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name; and we forbad him, because he followeth not with us.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea o Ioane, “Le Alii e, na matou iloa le tasi na ia tulia temoni i lou suafa; ona matou vavao lea ia te ia, aua ua ia le mulimuli mai ia te i tatou.”

verses.en: And Jesus said unto him, Forbid him not: for he that is not against us is for us.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu lea o Iesu ia te ia, “Aua tou te vaoia; ana o le le “au ese ia te outou, e “au faatasi lea ma outou.”

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the time was come that he should be received up, he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem,
verses.sm: Ua oo atu i ona po e siitia ai o ia, ona matuā faasaga atu lea o ia e maliu atu i Ierusalema;

verses.en: And sent messengers before his face: and they went, and entered into a village of the Samaritans, to make ready for him.
verses.sm: §2 ua aauina atu e ia nisi e muamua atu i le feau; ua latou o atu ma afe i le tasi aai o Samaria e sauni ai mo ia.

verses.en: And they did not receive him, because his face was as though he would go to Jerusalem.
verses.sm: A ua le talia o ia e i latou, aua ua faasaga atu lana malaga i Ierusalema.

verses.en: And when his disciples James and John saw this, they said, Lord, wilt thou that we command fire to come down from heaven, and consume them, even as Elias did?
verses.sm: Ua iloa e ona soo o Iakopo ma Ioane, ona la fai mai lea, “Le Alii e, pe e te finagalo, ma te fai atu ia alu ifo le au mai le lagi, ia fano ai i latou?”

verses.en: But he turned, and rebuked them, and said, Ye know not what manner of spirit ye are of.
verses.sm: A ua fáliu o ia, ma aoai ia te i laua.

verses.en: For the Son of man is not come to destroy men's lives, but to save them. And they went to another village.
verses.sm: Ona latou o atu lea i le tasi aai.

verses.en: And it came to pass, that, as they went in the way, a certain man said unto him, Lord, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
verses.sm: Ua latou o i le ala, ona fai mai lea o le tasi ia te ia, “Ou te mulimuli atu ia te oe i mea uma e te maliu atu i ai.”

verses.en: And Jesus said unto him, Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu ai lea o Iesu ia te ia, “E fai lua o alope, e fai foi mea e momoe ai manu felelei; a o le Atalii o le tagata, e leai se mea e moe aio ia.”

verses.en: And he said unto another, Follow me. But he said, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu o ia i le tasi, “Ina mulimuli mai ia ia te au.” A ua fai mai o ia, “Le Alii e, tuu mai ia ia te au, seʻi ou toa“ alu e tanu i loʻu tama.”

verses.en: Jesus said unto him, Let the dead bury their dead: but go thou and preach the kingdom of God.
verses.sm: A ua fetalai atu Iesu ia te ia, “Ina tuu pea ia i e ua oti e tanu i o latou tagata oti; a o oe, e te alu ma talai atu le malo o le Atua.”

verses.en: And another also said, Lord, I will follow thee; but let me first go bid them farewell, which are at home at my house.
verses.sm: Ua fai mai foi le tasi, “Le Alii e, ou te mulimuli atu ia te oe; a ia tuu mai ia te au, seʻi ou muai faamavae i loʻu aiga.”

verses.en: And Jesus said unto him, No man, having put his hand to the plough, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu Iesu ia te ia, “O lē tago lona lima i le suotosina, ma tepa i tua, e le tatau ia i le malo o le Atua.”
